entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Vivek Kumar Verma And 4 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Janendra Kumar Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mohammad Alishah Faruqi,Sanjay Singh
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. Heard Shri Janendra Kumar Verma, learned counsel appearing for the applicants, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State and Shri Mohammad Alishah Faruqi,
learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.2.
3.

The instant application has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C./528 of BNSS, 2023 challenging therein, the charge sheet dated 8.2.2024 filed against the applicants in connection to the Case Crime No. 1/2024 registered under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, in Police Station Jankipuram, District Lucknow.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the applicants has submitted that since it is a matrimonial dispute in between the applicants and opposite party no.2, the parties have settled their all dispute through Vivek Kumar Verma And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ... on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118879331/
1 a compromise contained at page no. 48 to this application.
5.

entities.text: Vivek Kumar Verma And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the applicants has further submitted that since the entire dispute had been settled amongst the parties, this application may be allowed and the charge sheet as well as the entire proceedings of the criminal case may be quashed.

6. Shri Mohammad Alishah Faruqi, learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.2 has submitted that the parties have entered into a compromise and he has no objection if the instant application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C./528 of BNSS, 2023 is allowed and the charge sheet as well as the entire proceedings of the criminal case are quashed.
7. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsels for the parties and find that the parties have settled their dispute amicably through compromise.
8. In view of the aforesaid reasons, this application is allowed.

The charge sheet dated 8.2.2024 filed in connection to Case Crime No.1/2024 registered under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act and the entire proceedings of the Crl. Case No. 98796 of 2024 (State Vs. Vivek Kumar Verma), are hereby quashed.
